vocabulary.definition: to discuss something formally in order to reach an agreement
vocabulary.example: The two countries will negotiate a trade deal next week.

vocabulary.definition: freedom from control or influence of others
vocabulary.example: The country celebrated its independence day with parades and fireworks.

vocabulary.definition: cutting or shaping something carefully to form a specific shape
vocabulary.example: The artist was carving a beautiful sculpture out of marble.

vocabulary.definition: not connected with religious or spiritual matters
vocabulary.example: The government declared itself a secular state, allowing freedom of religion for all citizens.

vocabulary.definition: belonging to, characteristic of, or suitable for a prince
vocabulary.example: The palace was decorated in a princely manner, with velvet drapes and golden chandeliers.

vocabulary.definition: the moving of something from its place or position
vocabulary.example: The displacement of families due to the flood required temporary shelters to be set up.
